Nora (PM): Quick kickoff: tying up action owners from the INF-2101 postmortem. We need explicit owners, RACI, and a short validation plan for each action. 5-minute round.
Sam (Eng): I can own the code-side fix for the request batching regression. ETA: 9 days. Will add tests and a feature-flagged rollout.
Izzy (SRE): I'll take monitoring + alert adjustments. Plan: tighten anomaly window and add a dedupe policy. ETA: 4 days.
Maya (Platform): I'll own the rollout playbook and staging soak. Need to coordinate with Sam on feature flag gate. ETA: 7 days.
Nora (PM): Splitting into tickets: INF-2101-01 (batching fix), INF-2101-02 (alerts + dashboards), INF-2101-03 (rollout playbook + soak).
ticket-bot: Created INF-2101-01, INF-2101-02, INF-2101-03: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2101-01
Sam (Eng): INF-2101-01 acceptance: 1) unit + integration tests added, 2) p50/p95 latency within 10% of baseline in staging, 3) rollback steps documented. Branch: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1402
Izzy (SRE): Alert rule draft for INF-2101-02 attached in ticket. Proposed dedupe window: 10m. Will include dashboard comparison screenshots for validation.
Maya (Platform): For INF-2101-03 acceptance: 1) 48h staging soak with synthetic traffic, 2) feature flag canary at 5% then 25%, 3) runbook updated with rollback checklist. I'll add the calendar invite for the soak.
Nora (PM): RACI suggestion: R=Sam, A=Nora, C=Izzy+Maya, I=oncall+platform-eng. Any objections?
Sam (Eng): Fine.
Izzy (SRE): +1.
Maya (Platform): OK.
Nora (PM): I'll add 2-3 "how to validate" bullets to each ticket and create a milestone linking these three. Setting provisional due dates: INF-2101-02 due 2072340000 (4 days), INF-2101-03 due 2072630000 (7 days), INF-2101-01 due 2072790000 (9 days).
Sam (Eng): Noted. FYI INF-2101-01 touches the batching config might need a short maintenance window; I will call it out in the ticket.
Izzy (SRE): I'll coordinate the maintenance window and add ops contacts.
Maya (Platform): I'll add the staging validation checklist and tag QA for sign-off.
Nora (PM): Great 94 I'll follow up at the weekly postmortem sync with status. If anything slips, flag here or update the ticket. Closing this thread once tickets have the validation bullets. :white_check_mark:
